identity.title: Powered Industrial Truck Pre-Shift Inspection Log — Forklift FL-2 (Toyota 8FGU25), September 2026, Portland Warehouse

scan.summary: This is the company's own daily pre-shift inspection log for forklift FL-2, a Toyota 8FGU25 propane truck at the Portland warehouse, covering September 2026. It records tick/X checks for each safety item (tires, forks, mast, horn, lights, brakes, steering, LPG tank, extinguisher, plate, guard) by shift, operator initials, and hours meter reading.
scan.freshness_note: The visible entries run only through Sep 17, 2026, ten days before today (Sep 27, 2026). It is not clear from this page whether the log continues beyond Sep 17 (page cropped) or whether inspections have simply not been logged since then — this should be confirmed.

gaps.title: Horn defect logged Sep 9 with no documented repair
gaps.description: The Sep 9 row marks the horn as defective (X) with the note that the horn was not working. Subsequent rows (Sep 10 onward) show the horn as OK again, but there is no entry documenting when or how the horn was repaired, who repaired it, or that it was verified safe before the truck was returned to service.
gaps.fix: Take FL-2 out of service immediately upon any safety-affecting defect and only return it to service after documented repair/verification; add a repair-confirmation line to the log (date, technician, verification) for the Sep 9 horn defect.

gaps.title: No logged inspection for Sep 3 or Sep 4, 2026
gaps.description: The daily entries jump directly from Sep 2 to Sep 7, 2026, with no rows for Sep 3 or Sep 4. If the truck was operated on either of those days, no pre-shift inspection was recorded for that shift.
gaps.fix: Confirm whether FL-2 was operated on Sep 3–4; if so, this is a missed inspection that should be noted and corrected going forward by logging a pre-shift check every day the truck is used.
gaps.locator: page 1, between Sep 2 and Sep 7 rows

facts.value: Horn marked defective (X) on Sep 9, 2026 with note 'Horn not working'; no repair entry follows before the truck resumed use on Sep 10
facts.affects: Confirms the truck was used on Sep 10 without a documented resolution of a safety-affecting defect from the prior day.

facts.value: No entries exist for Sep 3 or Sep 4, 2026; the log goes from Sep 2 directly to Sep 7
facts.locator: page 1, table rows Sep 2 to Sep 7
facts.affects: Confirms a break in the daily pre-shift inspection record for two calendar days.
